about: Video engine Phase 0 settings (the MVP). Pinned by the PNF Video Engine Blueprint, MVP build spec (https://claude.ai/artifact/3ssi8yGEKVxiL7JTD87kzS); changing a value here is a logged decision in coo/DECISIONS-<date>.md, never a call made mid-run.
stopNote: Set true by any live chat that hears Todd say "stop videos" (blueprint, Publishing operations: the kill switch); every run checks it first.
floorsNote: A and C floors are the blueprint's (d30 of 20 or more; closed30 of 20 or more). D's floor of 20: Todd, Oct 28, 3:43 am, "Go with recs" (coo/DECISIONS-2026-10-28.md).

voice.chosenNote: Todd picks one voice for all nine on the first preview (blueprint, Media and voice); until then the preview renders all five.

music.note: One bed from tools/music/library.json for all nine (blueprint: one music bed from our existing library). Quiet Math: calm, 84 bpm, 58.6 s, so it covers a 45 to 60 s cut.

cta.say: See your neighborhood free at proofnotfluff dot com slash rats.

posting.note: Todd, live chat, Oct 30, 2026: "I want to switch to 3 posts per day on each platform"; "Schedule the 3 video releases each day based on when it will give us the best performance." Slots and evidence: video/studio/research/runs/2026-10-30-cadence.md. A slot moves only by research/PERFORMANCE.md's weekly rule, logged in coo/DECISIONS. Todd, live chat, Oct 31, 2026, 9:08 am: "let’s add a fourth to the morning time" (morning 7:17 am: trade owners check phones before the first job; Facebook 8 AM to noon and Instagram 9 AM weekdays in Buffer's data).
